automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.policy: Only public sources visibly published or updated within the last 7 days relative to run time qualify. Missing, ambiguous, future-dated, boundary-only, or upstream-owned entity-only updates are excluded.

leaf_universe.selection_policy: Unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, ties by stable relative path sort.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot app introduced local sandboxing in public preview for local repository and working tree sessions, with per-project filesystem, network, and credential policy controls; unsupported OS enforcement fails closed.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local practice pages should treat sandbox settings as a concrete runtime control for destructive commands, prompt-injection blast-radius reduction, prototype promotion gates, and harness sizing for local sessions.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot app added OpenTelemetry export through enterprise-managed settings so administrators can analyze agent sessions, inspect model and tool spans, and centralize telemetry settings; prompt and response capture is excluded by default.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This supports local guidance that user-visible progress, runtime telemetry, and cost governance should be durable harness features rather than after-the-fact notes.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The weekly Copilot release grouped local sandboxing, OpenTelemetry, assisted approvals in JetBrains, conversation rewind for redirected agent sessions, clearer implementation-plan status, and remote Dev Container execution support.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The bundle shows enterprise coding agents converging on risk-tiered approvals, resumable/recoverable sessions, and remote execution surfaces that local operating models should cover together.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud public preview added proof-of-presence checks requiring interactive reauthentication or MFA before high-impact actions, with future support planned for pull request merges.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This is a concrete example of human presence checks for consequential operations, useful for approval boundaries, destructive-command controls, lifecycle gates, and prototype-to-cloud promotion controls.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub added a global default policy for eligible generally available Copilot features and supported client capabilities, including Copilot Code Review policy and MCP server policy, with the policy taking effect October 22, 2026.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local governance guidance should distinguish preview opt-in, general-availability defaults, and explicit enterprise decisions when promoting agent features into normal workflows.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Copilot in Slack and Teams gained richer conversation context, links from generated GitHub work back to source discussion, model switching, default owners/repositories, duplicate issue checks, clearer long-task status, and safer repository switching.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This strengthens local guidance that collaboration agents need traceable source context, explicit ownership defaults, status reporting, and safeguards against stale sessions acting in the wrong repository.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Qodo reported that review and validation of AI-generated code have become top delivery bottlenecks as AI expands across planning, coding, testing, review, security analysis, and bug fixing.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This supports local emphasis on layered review roles, lifecycle gates, and harness sizing by workflow complexity rather than a single undifferentiated AI review step.

qualifying_updates.visible_date_evidence: Article URL and page metadata show September 25, 2026.
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Help Net Security interview argued that prompts can describe agent boundaries but cannot enforce them, and that controls should be risk-tiered because approval for every production-related action can make agents unusable.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local approval-boundary and governance pages should preserve the difference between low-risk diagnostic autonomy and high-risk consequential actions.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: AWS framed prompt injection, excessive agency, and information disclosure as related failures of uncontrolled delegation across trust, action, and access handoffs in agentic systems.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This gives a public model for routing prompt-injection guidance into architecture and authorization boundaries instead of treating it only as content filtering.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: SecBriefs mapped enterprise AI-agent credential, plugin, runtime, and approval risks into a six-layer authority-control framework and emphasized the path from instruction to consequential action.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This supports local destructive-command and governance-control language focused on independent controls that can stop authority paths.

qualifying_updates.visible_date_evidence: Search result visible date Sun Sep 20 04:30:00 2026 UTC and article page content references local AI runtime and harness.
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Tom’s Guide reported NVIDIA commentary that easier local model harnesses and runtimes will increase local AI adoption, framing local execution as an ownership, privacy, and cost question as agents touch personal data.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Local runtime pages should watch the operational split between local model execution, harness security, data ownership, and cost optimization.

federation_notes: Broad product/model availability belongs upstream unless it changes local operating practice, guardrails, telemetry, approvals, or workflow routing.

GitHub Copilot, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, NVIDIA, OpenTelemetry, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and named model families are upstream-owned entities; this artifact records only downstream local-practice implications.
